---
title: "Electrostatic capacitance"
description: "Calculate a pad's capacitance from an explicitly defined conductor and dielectric environment."
sidebar: simulation
---

## Purpose and selected system

Calculate the capacitance of the SimplePad island relative to its surrounding
Ground. The selected layout is the public square-pad capacitor: a finite
island, an opening and connected surrounding metal above a single substrate.
This static problem does not determine resonant frequency or transmission.

## Model and boundary choices

Use the notebook's exact layout settings, stack and material records. Preserve
the island and Ground as distinct conductors, the opening as nonmetal and the
substrate as a dielectric volume. Metal representation, physical thickness
and the surrounding vacuum region belong to the selected model.

Specify the potential/reference assignment and the exterior treatment. A
finite grounded enclosure and an open exterior describe different problems.
Mesh and solver settings govern the numerical calculation; they do not change
which conductor the reported capacitance refers to. Concrete values and
convergence controls live in the notebook, not in a second settings table here.

::: {.callout-note}
A source image explains the layout. Native conductor, material and boundary
readback establishes the model actually used for extraction.
:::

## Workflow

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Palace

Use [SimplePad electrostatic](../../notebooks/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/palace_electrostatic.ipynb).
Follow its source construction, model/mesh preparation and solver handoff.
Analyze the returned run separately, preserving conductor ordering and units.

### AEDT

Use [SimplePad Q3D](../../notebooks/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_q3d.ipynb).
Construct the same intended conductor arrangement, inspect native material and
Net assignments, and extract the requested capacitance matrix. The Q3D
boundary and matrix convention must be stated before comparing with Palace.

:::

## Expected outputs

Retain the native model readback, applied setup, mesh/adaptive history and
returned capacitance entries with conductor names and units. Report the
chosen reference and any matrix reduction. Agreement between backend values
is an observation, not automatic equivalence of their physical models.

Continue with [materials and stack](../tools/materials-stack-z.qmd),
[mesh and numerical controls](../tools/mesh-fem-amr.qmd) and
[handoff, resolution and reporting](../tools/handoff-resolve-report.qmd).
